scenario_description:
Objective: Preserve Cassian’s ability to participate in a confirmed weekend 3D shoot without arriving under-equipped.
Emerging Need: A previously logged inventory gap becomes relevant only after the wait-list clears and the event’s matching-arrow rule applies.
Decision Context: Limited repair access and dwindling retail stock create a short window for a reversible, low-commitment hold or preparation step.
Consequence: If no timely coordination occurs, he may reach equipment check without the required arrow set and lose the practical benefit of his entry.

parameter.title: Sellwood 3D Fun Shoot tentative hold
parameter.description: Possible club outing; organizer is still reconciling wait-list invitations.

parameter.subject: Sellwood 3D Fun Shoot confirmation and equipment notes
parameter.body: Your wait-list place has cleared, and your Saturday entry is confirmed. Check-in opens at 8:15 a.m. Every shooter must present at least six matching, undamaged arrows at equipment check. Equipment notes may be updated until Thursday at 6:00 p.m.; no loaner arrow sets will be provided at the venue.

parameter.content: Heads up for anyone sorting gear: the workbench is open Thursday 4:30-6:30 only this week. I can rebuild one arrow if you bring parts, or tell me by today at 5:00 if you need me to set aside club fletching. Friday access is cancelled.

parameter.subject: Last call for Saturday-ready arrow singles
parameter.body: Matched 600-spine singles for this weekend are nearly gone. To guarantee pickup before Saturday events, reserve by 4:00 p.m. today; unreserved stock will be released to walk-in league customers this evening.

parameter.subject: Saturday-ready arrow singles sold out
parameter.body: All Saturday-ready matched 600-spine singles have been reserved or sold. New special orders will not arrive before next week.
